probability.label: Low Risk
recommendations: Continue routine cardiovascular health maintenance and periodic screening.
Reinforce heart-healthy lifestyle measures (diet, activity, smoking cessation).
Monitor blood pressure and lipid profile at routine follow-up visits.

probability.label: Moderate Risk
recommendations: Recommend clinical correlation and further evaluation as indicated.
Consider referral to Cardiology if risk factors persist or worsen.

probability.label: High Risk
recommendations: Correlate with ECG, biomarkers, echocardiography or stress testing as indicated.
